mapper.sql: f.uid, COALESCE(f.owner_uid, 'system') AS tenant_id, 'default' AS workspace_id, f.name, rel.parent_uid AS parent_uid, COALESCE(f.is_directory, false) AS is_directory, COALESCE(f.size, 0) AS size_bytes, COALESCE(f.content_type, 'application/octet-stream') AS content_type, COALESCE(f.root_location, '') AS storage_path, f.checksum AS checksum_sha256, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM f.createddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS created_at_epoch_ms, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM f.lastupdateddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS updated_at_epoch_ms
mapper.select: SELECT FROM unipost_fs_object f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT child_uid, parent_uid FROM unipost_fs_objectrelation ) rel ON f.uid = rel.child_uid WHERE f.uid = #{id} AND f.deleteddate IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM unipost_fs_object f INNER JOIN unipost_fs_objectrelation rel ON f.uid = rel.child_uid WHERE rel.parent_uid = #{parentUid} AND (f.owner_uid = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND f.deleteddate IS NULL ORDER BY f.name ASC

SELECT FROM unipost_fs_object f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT child_uid, parent_uid FROM unipost_fs_objectrelation ) rel ON f.uid = rel.child_uid WHERE f.is_directory = true AND (f.owner_uid = #{tenantId} OR #{tenantId} IS NULL) AND ( (#{parentUid} IS NULL AND rel.parent_uid IS NULL) OR (rel.parent_uid = #{parentUid}) ) AND f.deleteddate IS NULL ORDER BY f.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipost_fs_object ( uid, owner_uid, name, is_directory, size, content_type, root_location, checksum, createddate, lastupdateddate ) VALUES ( #{id.value}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{isDirectory}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentType}, #{storagePath}, #{checksumSha256}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{createdAtEpochMs} / 1000.0), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{updatedAtEpochMs} / 1000.0) ) ON CONFLICT (uid) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, is_directory = EXCLUDED.is_directory, size = EXCLUDED.size, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, root_location = EXCLUDED.root_location, checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum, lastupdateddate = EXCLUDED.lastupdateddate
INSERT INTO unipost_fs_objectrelation (parent_uid, child_uid, owner_uid) VALUES (#{parentUid}, #{childUid}, #{tenantId})
